title: Behaviour profile
description: One yokai temperament read by the deterministic AI state machine (Y1, Y2) in data/profiles/<id>.json. Every 'when' is on-screen state, never a button press (P6).

yokai.description: Whose profile it is. 'apprentice' (designer 2026-10-21): the row-1 apprentice's own profile; the node names it with 'profile' and plays as the Kitsune for body and kit, so it is never one of the Kitsune's temperaments.

reaction.description: Reaction-time tier and its frames (Y4). Y5 shaves 1 frame per Tanuki win at runtime; not stored here.

aggression_bias.description: 0 = fully patient, 100 = fully aggressive; Y5 pushes it up per Tanuki win.

habit.description: Exactly one learnable, punishable habit (Y2, P6).

tell_cover_pct.description: Difficulty knob (YOK-27): chance a habit that rolled true is held back anyway, so harder opponents show their tell less. Default 0.

guard_pct.description: YOK-165 (Y4, P6): pre-emptive guard. Each time the AI settles in its preferred range to wait, and each time it commits to a move of its own (not its habit), it holds crouch guard (down-back) with this chance: while waiting, or through that move's recovery and a short beat after, before any attack shows. The roll is on the AI's own decision, never on anything the player pressed. 0 = it guards only on reaction. Left out = ProfileAi.DefaultGuardPct, 0: off (designer 2026-10-20); a profile opts in by naming it.

ex_use.description: YOK-57 (E16, C5): when the AI picks a special and its own meter on screen covers the EX cost plus keep_meter, it asks for the EX version with chance_pct. Absent = never. E22: "The standard-tier AI doesn't use EX or burst yet." Applied only in elder and Tanuki fights (the node decides, not the profile).

keep_meter.description: Meter (100 = 1 bar) kept back after paying for the EX. Default 0.

burst_use.description: YOK-57 (C6, E13): on each hit the AI sees itself take, once it has taken min_combo_hits in a row and its health shows at most max_health_pct of the bar, it bursts with chance_pct (once per fight, from hitstun only: a thrown fighter breaks instead). Absent = never. E22: "The standard-tier AI doesn't use EX or burst yet." Applied only in elder and Tanuki fights (the node decides, not the profile).

min_combo_hits.description: Hits in a row seen before it considers bursting. Default 1.

max_health_pct.description: Only bursts at or below this share of its health bar. Default 100.

action.description: A move id (normal or special), a generic action, or special:copied = the Tanuki's copied special, resolved when the copy locks (T0, T1; YOK-94). 'copied' is reserved and is no special's id.
